meta.title: CPZ — CardputerZero OS
meta.desc: CPZ is a terminal-first Linux for the CardputerZero handheld. It starts in a text terminal, keeps your tabs open, and manages Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound and power from one Settings menu.
hero.lead: A Linux for the CardputerZero handheld that starts in a text terminal instead of a desktop. Open tabs, split the screen, connect Wi-Fi and change settings — all from the keyboard.
hero.note: This is a terminal system, not a desktop. Default login: cpz / cpz. Wi-Fi is off until you enable it in Settings.
why.title: Why CPZ
why.intro: Three things make CPZ different from a desktop Linux.
w1.d: There is no desktop to load. The terminal opens at boot, and Settings is a menu with arrow keys — not a config file.
w2.d: Change settings or plug in an HDMI monitor without losing your tabs, split screens or running programs.
w3.d: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, display, power and apps are managed in one place. No config files, no extra setup tools.
install.title: Install
install.intro: One download, one microSD card, no setup wizard. The image is based on Raspberry Pi OS and fits the CardputerZero hardware.
install.s1: Download the .img.xz file from Releases. You do not need the source code.
install.s2: Write it to a microSD card with Raspberry Pi Imager, balenaEtcher, dd or M5 Imager. Writing erases the card.
install.s3: Insert the card and power on. The first boot takes a little longer than later boots.
install.note: The release page lists the image size and checksum.
install.after.title: First 5 minutes
install.after.login: Log in as cpz / cpz, then set a new password in Settings → System.
install.after.wifi: Turn on Wi-Fi in Settings → Network. It is off by default.
install.after.power: Power off from Settings → Power. Do not pull the power.
install.after.keys: Press Alt+H for the key list and Alt+O to search.
install.after.usb: Plug in a USB drive; it opens in a new tab under /media.
keys.title: Key reference
keys.intro: Hold Alt and press the key. The same list is on the device: Alt+H. On the internal keyboard, plus and minus are Sym+T and Sym+R.
k.tabs.prev: Switch to the previous / next tab
k.panes.next: Switch to the next / previous split
k.panes.zoom: Zoom the current split (press again to restore)
k.session.display: Force the built-in screen / return to automatic
k.session.font: Make the text bigger / smaller (saved in Settings)
k.session.detach: Hide the session; log in again to return
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Change Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, display and power with the arrow keys and Enter. Settings opens in the last tab and stays available.
settings.network: Join Wi-Fi, check Ethernet, manage VPNs and addresses
settings.display: Theme, brightness, screen timeout, font size, status bar and HDMI output
settings.sound: Volume, mute, input and output device
settings.keyboard: Layout, active layout and the key list
settings.datetime: Date, time, time zone and automatic clock sync
settings.power: Battery status, restart, shut down and sleep
settings.apps: Browse, install and remove terminal apps
settings.system: About, memory and storage, password, remote access (SSH) and reset
help.title: Help
help.intro: Most answers are one shortcut away on the device: Alt+H for keys, Alt+O for search and Alt+S for Settings.
footer.based: Based on Raspberry Pi OS and pi-gen. Built for the CardputerZero handheld.
